<?php
class Target {
    public function __destruct() {
        global $weak, $hold, $count;
        $count += 1;
        echo "D", $count, ":";
        echo $weak->get() === $this ? "live|" : "lost|";
        $hold = $weak->get();
    }
}
$count = 0;
$hold = null;
$object = new Target();
$weak = WeakReference::create($object);
unset($object);
echo $weak->get() === $hold ? "held|" : "lost|";
unset($hold);
echo $weak->get() === null ? "gone|" : "live|";
echo $count, "|END";

<?php
class ChildObject {
    public function __destruct() {
        global $parentWeak;
        echo $parentWeak->get() === null ? "C:null|" : "C:live|";
    }
}
class ParentObject {
    public $child;
    public function __construct($child) { $this->child = $child; }
    public function __destruct() {
        global $parentWeak;
        echo $parentWeak->get() === $this ? "P:live|" : "P:lost|";
    }
}
$child = new ChildObject();
$parent = new ParentObject($child);
$parentWeak = WeakReference::create($parent);
unset($child);
unset($parent);
echo $parentWeak->get() === null ? "N|END" : "L|END";

<?php
class Target { public function __destruct() { echo "D|"; } }
$object = new Target();
$a = WeakReference::create($object);
$b = WeakReference::create($a);
$c = WeakReference::create($b);
echo $b->get() === $a ? "a|" : "wrong|";
echo $c->get() === $b ? "b|" : "wrong|";
unset($b);
echo $c->get() === null ? "goneb|" : "heldb|";
echo $a->get() === $object ? "alivea|" : "losta|";
unset($a);
echo $c->get() === null ? "stillgone|" : "revived|";
unset($object);
echo "END";

<?php
class Target { public function __destruct() { echo "T|"; } }
$object = new Target();
$first = WeakReference::create($object);
$watch = WeakReference::create($first);
$alias = $first;
unset($first);
echo $watch->get() === $alias ? "A|" : "lost|";
unset($alias);
echo $watch->get() === null ? "gone|" : "held|";
$second = WeakReference::create($object);
echo $second->get() === $object ? "fresh|" : "lost|";
echo $watch->get() === null ? "stillgone|" : "revived|";
$memo = WeakReference::create($object);
echo $memo === $second ? "memo|" : "new|";
unset($object);
echo $second->get() === null && $memo->get() === null ? "bothnull|END" : "live|END";

<?php
class Target {
    public function __construct() {
        global $weak;
        $weak = WeakReference::create($this);
        echo $weak->get() === $this ? "ctor:live|" : "ctor:lost|";
        throw new Exception("constructor failed");
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo "BAD-DESTRUCTOR|"; }
}
try { new Target(); } catch (Exception $e) { echo "caught|"; }
echo $weak->get() === null ? "null|END" : "live|END";

<?php
$class = "WeakReference";
$object = new stdClass();
$weak = $class::create($object);
$memo = $class::create($object);
echo $weak === $memo ? "memo|" : "new|";
echo $weak?->get() === $object ? "live|" : "lost|";
unset($object);
echo $weak?->get() === null ? "gone|END" : "held|END";

<?php
error_reporting(0);
class InnerObject292 implements ArrayAccess {
    public function __destruct() { echo "D:inner;"; }
    public function offsetExists(mixed $offset): bool { return false; }
    public function offsetGet(mixed $offset): mixed { return null; }
    public function offsetSet(mixed $offset,mixed $value): void { echo 'S:',$offset,':',$value,';'; $GLOBALS['written292']=$value; }
    public function offsetUnset(mixed $offset): void {}
}
class OuterObject292 implements ArrayAccess {
    public function __destruct() { echo "D:outer;"; }
    public function offsetExists(mixed $offset): bool { return false; }
    public function offsetGet(mixed $offset): mixed { echo 'G;'; $inner=$GLOBALS['inner292']; unset($GLOBALS['inner292'],$GLOBALS['o292']); return $inner; }
    public function offsetSet(mixed $offset, mixed $value): void { echo 'WRONGSET;'; }
    public function offsetUnset(mixed $offset): void { echo 'WRONGUNSET;'; }
}

$inner292=new InnerObject292; $o292=new OuterObject292;
$wi292=WeakReference::create($inner292); $wo292=WeakReference::create($o292);
set_error_handler(function($n,$m) { echo 'WRONGNOTICE;'; return true; },8);
$r292=($o292[1][7]=13);
restore_error_handler();
echo 'R:',$r292,':',$written292,':',(int)isset($inner292),':',(int)isset($o292),';';
echo "W:",(int)($wi292->get()===null),":",(int)($wo292->get()===null),";";
